query: Set up project-local cross-session memory in this repository. Track shared memory in Git, keep private notes local, and make sure new Codex or Pi sessions automatically load the handoff.

We're continuing the payments refactor in a fresh session. This repo already has .mwf; check what the last agent completed and whether there are Stripe migration decisions relevant to src/billing/ before changing code.
For this project, always run the schema compatibility check before applying database migrations. I have had to remind agents of this several times, so preserve it for future sessions.

We finally converted the embedded-object DOCX after Pandoc and two custom scripts failed. Record why those attempts failed, the LibreOffice command that worked, its validation evidence, and where each approach is still appropriate.
Finish this milestone and prepare a concise handoff for a new task tomorrow. Include the unresolved cache invalidation blocker and the next concrete action, but do not copy the whole git log.
There are three unchecked entries in .mwf/inbox.md. Classify them, redact anything credential-like, turn unclear long-term guidance into candidates, and leave the conflicts for my decision.
PREF-20260820-004 says to use pnpm, but the root AGENTS.md now requires npm. Work out the authority conflict, ask me if needed, and update the stale memory so this doesn't recur.
Please forget the project memory entry about the retired internal endpoint. Show me the exact matching IDs first and permanently remove only the one I authorize.

Our .mwf index is getting noisy after several branches merged. Find duplicate incidents, preserve unique scope and verification evidence, archive confirmed duplicates, and check the structure afterward.
Run a health check on this project's file memory. I suspect a hand-edited candidate has an invalid type and that a token may have been pasted into the inbox.
For this run only, skip the full integration suite because I am on a slow laptop. Just run the focused parser test and do not make this a permanent project rule.
Summarize the last five git commits and tell me which files changed most often. I don't need any persistent notes or handoff updates.
Fix the obvious typo in src/banner.ts, run its unit test, and stop. This is a one-line routine change with no reusable workaround.
Create task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md so this long research task survives context compaction inside the current session.
Explain how transformer key-value memory works and compare it with recurrent neural networks. This is a conceptual question, not a request to modify a project.
Help me choose a password manager that supports passkeys and family sharing. Please compare current prices and security audits.
Remember that my favorite color is green across every future conversation and every repository I open.
Inspect why Chrome localStorage is cleared after logout in our web app. The word memory appears in the bug report, but this is normal application-state debugging.
This file is currently being edited by another agent, so don't touch it during this coordination window. Continue with the unrelated CSS task.
The build failed once because I mistyped the command. Run the corrected npm test command; there is no need to preserve this trivial mistake for later sessions.
